body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Al Barsha South 3, Dubailand Area.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> If you're fluttering around Dubai with no plan, get yourself some tickets to Dubai Butterfly Garden. Conveniently located right next to Dubai Miracle Garden, you can head to the world’s largest covered butterfly garden right after.
>
> You'll see more butterflies than empty airspace as you wander around ten huge custom-built domes, each filled with thousands of beautifully winged creatures. There are over 45 species to try and spot here, all in different sizes and colors. Learn what they eat, how the butterflies evolve through each stage of their life, and what one feels like when it lands on your shoulder!
>
> Little kids and big kids alike will remember this experience forever.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €15.06. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 89 ratings and 28 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
